title: Your accounts, your way
summary: Connect your own AI accounts from Settings, see your credit history, and talk to Matrix on WhatsApp.

highlights.title: Connect AI accounts in Settings
highlights.body: Sign in to your own AI provider accounts right from Settings and see each one's status. Account actions are back, and your credentials stay protected.

highlights.title: WhatsApp, confirmed
highlights.body: Link your WhatsApp account from a chat. Matrix reacts to your messages while it works and when it's done.

items.text: Matrix AI credits and usage history are back in Settings.
Matrix AI now powers Pi chats, bots, integrations and MCP tools.
Bot conversations have their own place, and project navigation is updated.
Shared projects and their chats open in the Chats app.
Moving a chat between projects keeps its model context.
Matrix AI chats start reliably again.
